subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu document attachments lose their durable local reference after inline truncation

question: Should durable inbound attachments use a generic session-scoped managed reference, or may Feishu persist raw host paths directly in transcript text?
rationale: The narrow raw-path workaround is easy, but attachment lifetime, cross-agent authorization, path disclosure, cleanup, and ownership are security and product contracts that should not be chosen implicitly by an automated repair.

options.title: Managed attachment reference
options.body: Add an opaque message/session-bound reference backed by canonical SQLite metadata and resolve it only for the owning agent; this is the recommended durable design.

options.title: Feishu raw-path descriptor
options.body: Append the exact downloaded path to Feishu transcript text, accepting path disclosure, cleanup staleness, and channel-specific behavior as explicit tradeoffs.

recommendation.title: Managed attachment reference
recommendation.body: Add an opaque message/session-bound reference backed by canonical SQLite metadata and resolve it only for the owning agent; this is the recommended durable design.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties this person directly to Feishu rich-media ingestion and message-context behavior.
